reentry_during_transferfrom.meaning: a re-entrant call into an external function occurs during the external transferFrom call

transferfrom_in_progress.meaning: an external transferFrom call is executing within a state-changing external function

tokens_stolen.meaning: tokens are stolen, potentially in combination with other weaknesses

assumptions: The external transferFrom call is part of a state-changing external function on the Distributor contract.
Re-entry means a nested call into an external function while transferFrom is executing.

unresolved.description: The report states token theft only as a potential outcome 'may be combined with other weaknesses'; the direct observable of token theft magnitude/recipient is not defined, so V cannot assert a definite theft beyond the potential re-entry scenario.

limitations: No frozen P sources were selected; the rule has an empty precondition conjunction.
The impact is potential; the plan encodes the report-supported re-entry scenario rather than an inevitable theft.
